channel.title: D2 Item of the Day
channel.description: One rare Diablo 2 collector's item every day.

item.title: Ber Rune
item.description:
Ber Rune
the currency after SoJ

Rarity: Mythic

When duping crashed the Stone of Jordan, the economy needed a unit that was harder to inflate, and it landed on high runes. The Ber became the standard. It is rare, it is needed for the best runewords, and it is small enough to price anything against. For years gear was quoted in Bers and Jahs the way it was once quoted in SoJs.

item.title: Tomb Reaver
item.description:
Tomb Reaver
3os Tomb Reaver

Rarity: Very Rare

Two Tomb Reavers can be worlds apart. It rolls one to three sockets and an enhanced damage range that swings by eighty percent. Only a three-socket copy at the top of the range is the one people chase. Then it hands you sixty attack speed, fifty all resist, and eighty magic find on top of monster damage. The name is the same on all of them. The roll is everything.

item.title: Eth Cruel Mythical Sword
item.description:
Eth Cruel Mythical Sword
eth Cruel sword

Rarity: Very Rare

A blue sword that reads like a vendor sale and hits like an elite runeword. Cruel is the most damage a magic weapon can roll, and a perfect one lands at three hundred percent; this one rolled two seventy four. Ethereal stacks another fifty on the base. On a Mythical Sword, one of the hardest-hitting one-handers in the game, that is more raw damage than most gold weapons carry, for the price of a blue drop. Nothing on the name warns you.

item.title: Herald of Zakarum
item.description:
Herald of Zakarum
200 ED HoZ

Rarity: Very Rare

A Herald of Zakarum is a paladin staple, so people assume they are all the same. They are not. The enhanced defense rolls from a hundred and fifty to two hundred percent, and only a two hundred is worth chasing. Punch four sockets into that one and you have one of the best shields a paladin can hold. A low roll is a leveling shield. The gap between the two is enormous, and the tooltip barely hints at it.

item.title: Bugged Shaftstop
item.description:
Bugged Shaftstop
the ebug 2400 defense armor

Rarity: Very Rare

Shaftstop is a beginner's armor. This one shows two thousand four hundred defense, roughly triple what the item can legitimately reach. It is the ethereal socketing bug: cube a socket into an ethereal armor and the game applies the ethereal defense bonus a second time, stacking a number the math never allows. Same gold name, an armor from a different reality.

item.title: 1.08 Harlequin Crest
item.description:
1.08 Harlequin Crest
the 40% maximum life Shako

Rarity: Very Rare

The Shako everyone wears gives life and mana by character level, ten percent damage reduced, and two points in every attribute. This one gives forty percent maximum life on one line, and it cannot break. No helm the game makes now carries a percentage of maximum life at all. Same two skills, same magic find, a completely different reason to wear it.

item.title: Glitched Arreat's Face
item.description:
Glitched Arreat's Face
the Zod-bug antique

Rarity: Mythic

A normal Arreat's Face cannot be indestructible, and cannot show six hundred defense. This one is both. It is an ethereal Arreat's that a Zod rune locked permanently indestructible, keeping the ethereal defense bonus with no durability left to lose, and the defense was doubled again by the old ethereal socketing bug. The current game cannot produce it: eternal, ethereal, and armored past its own ceiling.
